description: Use this when the user asks what size envelope to use or how big an envelope is ("what size envelope for a 5x7 card", "#10 envelope size", "a7 envelope size", "envelope for a letter folded in thirds", "dl envelope size in inches"). Give a card, photo or folded sheet size and it lists the envelopes it fits with at least 1/8 in to spare, smallest first; give an envelope name and it returns its size in inches and mm, what it is used for and its USPS mail shape (letter, nonmachinable or large envelope). Does not print anything (use generate_envelope_pdf) and does not give postage prices.

height.description: Height of the card or insert, e.g. 7.

query.description: A card or sheet size, an envelope name, or a use, e.g. "5x7 card", "letter folded in thirds", "A4 folded in half", "#10", "A7" or "wedding invitation".

width.description: Width of the card or insert, e.g. 5 or "127 mm".

name: find_envelope_size
title: Find envelope size
